description: This file defines a struct for representing hook jobs and an actor that executes these hooks with specified configurations, including process management, environment setup, and timeout handling.

classes.name: HookExecutor
classes.description: An actor responsible for executing hook commands with proper configuration, timeout, and environment management.

methods.name: shouldRun
methods.description: Determines if the hook should run based on cooldown settings.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the hook command asynchronously, with timeout handling and environment setup.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the HookExecutor with configuration and hostname.
